subject.title: feat(providers): add Qwen Cloud individual token-plan provider

question: Should CodexBar support Qwen Cloud's individual token plan as a first-class cookie-authenticated provider despite its external account and endpoint dependency?
rationale: This PR adds new provider, configuration, documentation, and support surface; implementation quality alone cannot decide whether that ongoing product commitment fits the repository.

options.title: Sponsor the provider
options.body: Accept Qwen Cloud as a supported provider once real authenticated behavior and shared Alibaba compatibility are demonstrated.

options.title: Keep it out of core
options.body: Decline first-class support if the external service is too account-specific or unstable to maintain as a provider.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the provider
recommendation.body: Accept Qwen Cloud as a supported provider once real authenticated behavior and shared Alibaba compatibility are demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership is the clearest available signal for the supported-provider product boundary.
